meta.title: Āyurvedīya Śabdakośa, vol. 1 — index of headwords and citations
meta.source: Veṇīmādhavaśāstrī Jośī & Nārāyaṇa Harī Jośī, Āyurvedīya Śabdakośa, vol. 1. Mumbaī: Mahārāṣṭra Rājya Sāhitya-Saṃskṛti Maṇḍaḷa, 1968.
meta.note: Headwords, grammatical gender, page and column, and the citations of each entry only; the glosses are not included. Read from the scan by OCR; the headwords on which the OCR readings disagreed or which Monier-Williams does not list were then read by eye from the scan by Claude (an AI model), which the entry marks with read: eye. Headword status: ok = the reading has independent support (two OCR readings and the word list; or the reading by eye and an OCR reading or the word list); probable = a reading by eye without such support, or an uncertain one with it; check = uncertain or not legible. lex says what the word list has: mw, compound (two listed words), member (of a sub-entry), corrected, none.
